code: import axios from'axios';const API_BASE_URL='http://localhost:5000/api/raid';export const createRaidArray=async raidConfig=>{try{const response=await axios.post("".concat(API_BASE_URL,"/create"),raidConfig);return response.data;}catch(error){throw new Error("Error creating RAID array: ".concat(error.message));}};export const writeToRaid=async(raidId,data)=>{try{const response=await axios.post("".concat(API_BASE_URL,"/write"),{raidId,data});return response.data;}catch(error){throw new Error("Error writing to RAID array: ".concat(error.message));}};export const simulateCrash=async(raidId,diskIndex)=>{try{const response=await axios.post("".concat(API_BASE_URL,"/simulate-crash"),{raidId,diskIndex});return response.data;}catch(error){throw new Error("Error simulating crash: ".concat(error.message));}};export const replaceDisk=async(raidId,diskIndex)=>{try{const response=await axios.post("".concat(API_BASE_URL,"/replace-disk"),{raidId,diskIndex});return response.data;}catch(error){throw new Error("Error replacing disk: ".concat(error.message));}};export const getRaidStatus=async raidId=>{try{const response=await axios.get("".concat(API_BASE_URL,"/status/").concat(raidId));return response.data;}catch(error){throw new Error("Error retrieving RAID status: ".concat(error.message));}};export const readFromDisk=async(raidId,diskIndex)=>{try{const response=await axios.get("".concat(API_BASE_URL,"/read-disk/").concat(raidId,"/").concat(diskIndex));return response.data;}catch(error){throw new Error("Error reading from disk: ".concat(error.message));}};
